description:
The West Lake 6 Drawer Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides for onesies, sleepers, blankets, and more, in a solid hardwood frame.

It measures 56 inches wide, 34 inches high, and 21½ inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete West Lake collection.
title: West Lake 6 Drawer Dresser
